independent_recapture.method: Run the unchanged generator with runpy.run_path under a non-main name, then call generate(contexto) in memory using the shared Python3.12 offline reference interpreter, current task KG, Django TestClient, account/submission flags off and bytecode writing disabled. The generator main file-writing block was not invoked.

rationale: Independently inspected every old/new sequence and action. Only the normal difficulty, seed 1, empty-category/non-daily sequence at index 24 changes. Its ten affected response bodies carry one guess rank moving from 1290 to 1291 plus mechanically consistent rank-history and feedback derivatives. No request, creation state, status, body schema/type, hidden answer, target identity or unrelated response leaf changes. The historical gzip decompresses byte-for-byte to the original Git baseline, and the generator itself is byte-identical to that baseline. An independent full in-memory Django capture reproduced the complete current vector file exactly, so expectations were not derived from native outputs or manually patched rank fields. This accepts the bounded test-vector refresh reflecting the reviewed graph ripple. It does not lower an assertion, waive native tests, rewrite historical evidence, approve source/runtime changes or replace the final assembled-code/source review. The parent-reported focused native race run is separate; this reviewer independently recaptured Django but did not rerun that native command.
valid_until: Current KG, reference generator, vectors or reviewed graph impact changes; then capture and review again.
